text: In healthcare, biased or stale training data produces algorithms that misdiagnose underrepresented populations and thereby reinforce existing health disparities instead of reducing them.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Artificial Intelligence The Final Frontier (2025). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=5095633
abstract: In healthcare, for instance, biased or stale training data could lead to algorithms that misdiagnose underrepresented populations, reinforcing existing health disparities rather than alleviating them.
